description: This file provides C++11-compatible implementations of type trait utilities, detection idioms, and related template metaprogramming constructs used within the Abseil library. It defines traits such as void_t, conjunction, disjunction, negation, and others, along with internal mechanisms for type detection, hashability assertions, and swap traits, primarily for use in template metaprogramming and type inference.

classes.name: VoidTImpl
classes.description: Internal template for implementing void_t metafunction.

classes.name: is_detected_impl
classes.description: Internal template for detection idiom, checks if an operation is valid.

classes.name: is_detected
classes.description: Template to check if a certain template operation is valid for given types.

classes.name: is_detected_convertible_impl
classes.description: Internal template to check if an operation's result is convertible to a type.

classes.name: is_detected_convertible
classes.description: Template to check if an operation's result is convertible to a specified type.

classes.name: default_alignment_of_aligned_storage
classes.description: Internal helper to determine default alignment for aligned storage.

methods.name: void_t
methods.description: Creates a void type from a list of types, used for SFINAE detection.

methods.name: conjunction
methods.description: Logical AND of multiple type traits, short-circuits on false.

methods.name: disjunction
methods.description: Logical OR of multiple type traits, short-circuits on true.

methods.name: negation
methods.description: Logical NOT of a type trait.

methods.name: is_function
methods.description: Checks if a type is a function type.

methods.name: is_trivially_relocatable
methods.description: Detects if a type can be relocated trivially, using compiler builtin if available.

methods.name: is_constant_evaluated
methods.description: Detects if code is evaluated in a constant context (C++20 and later).
